research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sisense is researching systems and methods for efficiently querying data using temporal granularities, as well as techniques for displaying data based on temporal data requirements. They are also developing approaches for representing query elements in artificial neural networks by mapping vectors to query elements, and improving user interfaces for executing data operations by identifying user accounts across connection graphs. These areas reflect a focus on scalable analytics, data modeling, and user interaction.
